exposure: Etiologies of PPH (uterine atony, retained tissue, trauma, thrombin disorders)
Interventions used (uterotonics, blood transfusion, manual removal of placenta, hysterectomy, uterine artery ligation)
cohort: The study included 73 postpartum women diagnosed with PPH at a hospital in Karimnagar, Telangana, India.
finding: Uterine atony was the most common cause of PPH (39.7%) in this rural population, which resulted in a 5.5% maternal mortality rate.
mod_finding: Cesarean delivery was more common (57.5%) than vaginal delivery among the women experiencing PPH in this cohort.
